description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST Controller for managing category resources in a web application, including operations to retrieve, create, and delete categories associated with merchant stores.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryRESTController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling REST endpoints for category operations such as retrieval, creation, and deletion for merchant stores.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch details of a category by ID for a specific store, considering language preferences.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new category for a specific merchant store, accepting category data in the request body.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a category by ID from a specific store.
